meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing is the final human-required handoff because the maintainer raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成版本号递增、构建校验、git 标签与发布说明生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动改版本号、打标签、写发布说明。
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps, build checks, git tags, and changelog generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every release means manually editing versions, tagging, and writing release notes.

howto.what: 它会自动完成插件版本升级：同步更新所有清单文件里的版本号，运行构建，代码提交、打标签、推送，创建 GitHub Release，并重新生成 changelog。npm 发布留给你手动执行。
howto.when: 当你说要升级版本号或执行发布流程时（如“bump version”）触发。

say.text: 帮我执行一次patch版本升级并走完发布流程
say.note: 它更新版本并走完除npm发布外的步骤，最后请你手动发布。
会同步各版本文件，提交推送并更新 changelog。

say.text: 为当前插件创建一个minor版本的GitHub Release
say.note: 会完成除 npm 发布外的所有准备，等你确认。

howto.what_en: Updates versions in all manifests, builds, commits, tags, pushes, creates a GitHub Release, and regenerates the changelog. npm publishing stays human-only.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to bump a version or run the release workflow.

say_en.text: Run a patch version bump and go through the release workflow.
say_en.note: Pre-release steps are done; npm stays for you to run.

say_en.text: Bump the version from 1.2.3 to 1.2.4 and regenerate the changelog.
Create a minor-version GitHub Release for this plugin.
say_en.note: Completes prep except npm; waits for your confirmation.
